pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Acropolis.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: In singleplayer interact with inactive Scylla in the Acropolis: the native route does not require an offering. Watch for whip swings, spinning strikes and separate lightning attacks; leave the attack sector before retaliating. Weapon changes alter the useful spacing.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. In singleplayer interact with inactive Scylla in the Acropolis: the native route does not require an offering. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Lacrima, Music Disc, Essence of the Storm. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Cursed Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
